subject: general
question:
Fuzail has 6 pencils A, B, C, D, E and F. He has kept them in two boxes Y and Z. D and B are not kept together. A and F are not kept together. D and A are not kept in box Z. E and C are not kept together. E is not kept in box Y.

Which of the following pencils is kept in box Z?
solution:
**Boxes :** Y and Z

**Pencils : **A, B, C, D, E and F. 

Step 1) E is not kept in box Y. E and C are not kept together.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ce60adb3216568207b6ab9cab4faf3ef7616cdd098525209fd57ecb322c57c98.png] 

Step 2) D and A are not kept
